trickyParts: The old sentence was not merely imprecise; its mechanism was wrong. The listener's fanout source skip (cmd/listener/delivery.go:638) only suppresses a push, and for a session registered selfSubscribed with port 0 the push is skipped before that anyway (packages/envoy/internal/session/session.go:62-65, 'The session consumes its own NATS subscription; there is nothing to push to'). The message had already reached the session over its own NATS subscription. A JetStream publish is still a publish on the subject, so a core subscriber of a captured subject is handed it exactly as it is handed an ad-hoc one — which is why the rig's AC2 row RECEIVED notifications.github.probe.all all along.

The role lane really is different, and the tool's `undelivered` flag is right: registerSession excludes role-bound subjects from the session's own NATS topics (extensions/envoy.ts:1505), so a role is delivered by the listener forwarding to the holder's agent subject, and the forward is dropped when the holder is the source. Keeping that half of the old advice while correcting the rest is what the two probes settle.
